struck: The resort's 2021 owner manual set the management fee at 35 percent.
use: An owner manual from 2017, the copy a listing site posted, set the management fee at 35 percent.

struck: It asked the owner's approval only for a single repair over $500.
use: It asked the owner's approval for any single repair over $500, unless the owner could not be reached or an emergency could not wait.

struck: An owner who sent a guest to the desk earned a referral commission instead: 20 percent of the nightly rate in most months, 15 percent in June and August, none in July.
use: An owner who booked a guest through the management office earned a referral commission: 20 percent of the nightly rate in most months, 15 percent in June and August, and none in July, on monthly stays or on discounted rates.

struck: a phone line with voicemail through the resort's phone company
use: a phone line with voicemail through Kingston Communications, the phone service the program named

struck: Units were inspected, refurbished at least every ten years, and removed from the program if work rated "below standard" was not done in time.
use: Units were inspected, were expected to be updated at least once every ten years, and were removed from the program if work rated "below standard" was not done in time.

pattern: \bchecked in at the (?:hotel )?front desk like any guest\b
struck: The owner booked personal stays through the management office during office hours and checked in at the hotel front desk like any guest.
use: The owner booked personal stays through the management office during office hours, and the manual asked owners to check in at the hotel front desk like any guest.

struck: and a name or marketing that says hotel, motel or resort.
use: a name that says hotel, motel or resort, unless the word only refers to the building's past use; or marketing as a hotel, resort or investment.

struck: every unit has a keycard lock on the resort's key system
use: every unit on the rental program had a keycard lock on the resort's key system

struck: phones run through the resort's phone service
use: phones ran through the phone service the program named

struck: An owner who books a guest directly needs one.
use: An owner who books guests directly needs one, unless the unit is rented no more than one week in each calendar quarter.

struck: Anything else stays with the host.
use: Airbnb also collects the local sales taxes the state collects for counties and towns. The host handles any other tax.

struck: If the owner stays more than 14 nights a year, or more than 10 percent of the nights it is rented, the IRS counts the condo as a home.
use: If the owner's personal days are more than the greater of 14 days or 10 percent of the days it is rented at a fair price, the IRS counts the condo as a home.

pattern: \bthree of the Kingston Plantation towers\b|\bKingston Plantation\b[^.]{0,80}\bRoyale Palms\b

use: The three towers the manual names, Brighton Towers and South Hampton at Kingston Plantation and Royale Palms at Kingston Shores, all have units for sale now: South Hampton 8 of 11 say they are in a rental program, Royale Palms 8 of 12, Brighton Towers 6 of 9.
